clo_details: Identify relevant data science techniques for addressing Capstone Project topics.
Formulate clear problem statements and objectives in project proposals.
Plan and execute data collection and cleaning procedures effectively.
Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover patterns and insights in data.
Develop and deploy machine learning models tailored to project requirements.
Evaluate, refine, and optimize machine learning models for improved performance.
Interpret and visualize results effectively to communicate findings to stakeholders.
Summarize conclusions drawn from data analysis and provide actionable recommendations.
Compile comprehensive final project reports integrating insights and methodologies learned throughout the course.
Enhance oral presentation skills through participation in Team Meetings and Final Presentations.
